name: MC95D Star Cruiser
description: The MC95D Star Cruiser was a class of Mon Calamari Star Cruiser that was present in the galaxy by the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance. In 35 ABY, many MC95D Star Cruisers were present on Exegol as part of the Citizens' Fleet that participated in the Battle of Exegol between the Resistance and the Sith Eternal.
